# CRX API Quickstart

> The CRX API Quickstart pages of Discover and the CRX FIX Quickstart, in Markdown. The taker and maker pages match the live Discover pages. SDK: https://github.com/crxfoundation/crx-python. Blocks tagged `crx-*` are Discover page elements.

## Pages

- [Taker API Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/taker-quickstart.md): Request quotes, trade and read your book on CRX.
- [Maker API Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/maker-quickstart.md): Open a 100 USD maker test trade and read it back.
- [FIX Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/fix/quickstart.md): Connect a FIX 4.4 engine to CRX, make a first trade as a taker and send a first quote as a maker. The [Rules of Engagement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/fix/rules-of-engagement.md), the dictionary [FIX44-CRX.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/fix/FIX44-CRX.xml) and the sample messages in fix/examples/ are beside it.

## Scripts

- [Taker script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/taker-script.py): the taker steps as one script.
- [Maker script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crxfoundation/crx-quickstart/main/maker-script.py): the maker steps as one script, with more calls.
